cues.text: Go into stitch 2 — under both top loops
The hook pokes out the back
Wrap the yarn over your hook — back to front
Pull it back through — 2 loops on your hook
Leave it on the hook and go into stitch 2
The hook pokes out the back
Wrap the yarn over your hook — back to front
Pull it back through — 3 loops on your hook
Wrap the yarn over again — back to front
Two stitches joined at the top — that's a decrease
